body: A sharp, intuitive mind with quick insight into other people's real motives, not their surface. Inner life is complex and layered.
business: Incisive perception and the nerve to say what others won't.
shadow: A cutting, alienating tongue, or impatience with people who live by convention.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
